description: 28 source-grounded Q/A cases plus 8 adversarial cases, including 2 direct and 2 genuinely retrieved indirect injection cases. No patient records. Public recommendations retain their historical source/version scope.
reference_method: Literal source anchors are whitespace-normalized and resolved to actual indexed chunk UUIDs in the pinned corpus. expected_chunk_ids is empty in portable data because #8 document/chunk UUIDs include uploader identity; all resolved IDs appear in each report.
claim_method: Verbatim source support, answer-anchor coverage, exact refusal, and conservative lexical high-risk-claim checks. Not a clinical correctness or semantic entailment oracle.
